In the Go codebase at /bench/repo, I need to find:
1. All RPC handler methods (likely gRPC service implementations) that can transitively cause an outbound HTTP request to a user-configured URL (like webhooks).
2. The convergence function where all those paths meet before actually sending the HTTP request.

Search strategy:
- Look for webhook-related code: grep for "webhook", "http.Post", "http.Do", "httpClient", "http.NewRequest", "net/http" in Go files
- Look for RPC service implementations (gRPC handlers) in the server/ or internal/ directories
- Trace the call chain from handlers down to the HTTP dispatch function
- Look for any "activity" or "notification" or "dispatch" patterns that might connect RPC handlers to outbound HTTP calls

Report all RPC handler method names that can transitively trigger outbound HTTP requests, and the single function where those code paths converge before making the HTTP call. Include file paths.

content.text: I now have a complete picture. Let me verify one more thing -- the exact convergence point where `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` and `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` both call into `webhook.PostAsync`.

I now have a complete and clear picture of the entire call chain. Here is my report.

---

## Results

### The Convergence Function

All code paths that send an outbound HTTP request to a user-configured webhook URL converge at a single function:

**`webhook.Post`** in `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go` (line 131)

This is the function that actually constructs the `http.NewRequest("POST", ...)`, signs it (if a signing secret is set), and calls `safeClient.Do(req)` to execute the outbound HTTP request. Every webhook dispatch in the codebase reaches this function through **`webhook.PostAsync`** (line 184 in the same file), which enqueues the payload into a bounded channel (`asyncPostQueue`). Four goroutines launched at init time drain that channel and call `webhook.Post` for each payload.

There is no other path to `safeClient.Do` or any other outbound HTTP call to user-configured URLs in the webhook package.

### RPC Handler Methods That Transitively Trigger Outbound Webhook HTTP Requests

There are exactly **5 RPC handler methods** on `APIV1Service` (the core service implementation, also exposed via ConnectRPC through `ConnectServiceHandler` delegation) that can transitively cause an outbound webhook HTTP request. Each is in `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/`:

| # | RPC Handler Method | File | Webhook Activity Type | Call Chain to `webhook.Post` |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **`CreateMemo`** | `memo_service.go:70` | `memos.memo.created` | `CreateMemo` -> `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |
| 2 | **`UpdateMemo`** | `memo_service.go:401` | `memos.memo.updated` | `UpdateMemo` -> `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |
| 3 | **`DeleteMemo`** | `memo_service.go:518` | `memos.memo.deleted` | `DeleteMemo` -> `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |
| 4 | **`CreateMemoComment`** | `memo_service_comments.go:21` | `memos.memo.created` AND `memos.memo.comment.created` | Two paths: (a) calls `CreateMemo` internally, which dispatches `memos.memo.created`; (b) directly calls `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |
| 5 | **`SetMemoAttachments`** | `memo_attachment_service.go:16` | `memos.memo.updated` | `SetMemoAttachments` -> `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |
| 6 | **`SetMemoRelations`** | `memo_relation_service.go:16` | `memos.memo.updated` | `SetMemoRelations` -> `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` -> `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook` -> `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` -> `webhook.PostAsync` -> `webhook.Post` |

(That is 6 handlers total -- I initially said 5 but `SetMemoRelations` is a distinct sixth.)

### Call Graph Summary

```
RPC Handlers (APIV1Service methods)
  |
  |-- CreateMemo ---------> DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook -------\
  |-- UpdateMemo ---------> dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects ---+--> dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook --\
  |-- DeleteMemo ---------> DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook ------/                                  |
  |-- SetMemoAttachments -> dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects ---/                                  |
  |-- SetMemoRelations ---> dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects ---/                                  |
  |                                                                                              |
  |-- CreateMemoComment --> DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook ----+                              |
  |          \                                                    |                              |
  |           \--> CreateMemo (internal) --> DispatchMemoCreated--/                              |
  |                                                               |                              |
  +---------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------+
                                                                  |
                                                          webhook.PostAsync  (enqueue)
                                                                  |
                                                          webhook.Post       <-- CONVERGENCE POINT
                                                                  |
                                                          safeClient.Do(req) (outbound HTTP POST)
```

### Key Files

- `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/webhook.go` -- Core webhook module containing `Post` (the convergence function, line 131) and `PostAsync` (line 184), plus the SSRF-safe HTTP client
- `/bench/repo/internal/webhook/validate.go` -- URL and signing secret validation
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go` -- Intermediate dispatch layer: `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`, `DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook`, `DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook`, `DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook`, and the shared `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook`
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` -- `CreateMemo`, `UpdateMemo`, `DeleteMemo` RPC handlers
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_service_comments.go` -- `CreateMemoComment` RPC handler
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_attachment_service.go` -- `SetMemoAttachments` RPC handler
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_relation_service.go` -- `SetMemoRelations` RPC handler
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/memo_update_helpers.go` -- `dispatchMemoUpdatedSideEffects` helper (used by `UpdateMemo`, `SetMemoAttachments`, `SetMemoRelations`)
- `/bench/repo/server/router/api/v1/connect_services.go` -- ConnectRPC wrapper that delegates to the `APIV1Service` methods above
